candidates.title: Include a staged repair pipeline before adding autonomous orchestration
candidates.rule: When choosing a repository-repair harness, benchmark a fixed localization, repair and validation pipeline alongside autonomous tool orchestration.
candidates.passage: Agentless uses a simple three phase approach of localization, repair, and patch validation.
candidates.finding: Agentless reports 38.8% on SWE-bench Verified with GPT-4o and strong results relative to historical agent baselines. The recommendation is to test the simpler baseline, not a causal claim that removing agency produces the gain.
candidates.conditions: Fixed stages constrain future actions. Inspected analysis finds relatively weaker results when issue descriptions provide no localization clues.
candidates.limitations: Baseline implementations, budgets and models vary; no universal superiority or current ranking follows. Closed-model training contamination remains unresolved. Full method and component ablations were not reviewed.
candidates.validation_test: Compare fixed and autonomous pipelines using the same model, candidate budget and tests; stratify by whether location clues are available and measure cost per resolved issue.

review_scope: Selected abstract, introduction, methods or main-result sections; not a comprehensive paper or appendix review.
